theorem probe_alpha_coarse :
    (0.6044 : ℝ) < (1/2 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1) ∧
    (1/2 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1) < 0.6045 := by
  have hpl : (3.1415926535 : ℝ) < Real.pi := by
    have := Real.pi_gt_d20; linarith
  have hpu : Real.pi < (3.1415926536 : ℝ) := by
    have := Real.pi_lt_d20; linarith
  have hel := Real.exp_one_gt_d9
  have heu := Real.exp_one_lt_d9
  have he : 0 < Real.exp 1 := Real.exp_pos 1
  have hpi : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hy : 0 < 2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1 := by positivity
  have hyl : (2 * 3.1415926535 / 2.7182818286 : ℝ) < 2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1 := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num) he]
    nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hpl) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2.7182818286),
      mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 3.1415926535) (sub_pos.2 heu)]
  have hyu : 2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1 < (2 * 3.1415926536 / 2.7182818283 : ℝ) := by
    rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ he (by norm_num)]
    nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hpu) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2.7182818283),
      mul_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 3.1415926536) (sub_pos.2 hel)]
  have h1 : ((1511:ℝ)/1250) < Real.logb 2 (2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1) := by
    rw [Real.lt_logb_iff_rpow_lt (by norm_num) hy]
    apply lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 1250 hy.le
    have h : ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1511:ℝ)/1250)) ^ (1250:ℕ) = 2 ^ (1511:ℕ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
      have : (1511:ℝ)/1250 * ((1250:ℕ):ℝ) = ((1511:ℕ):ℝ) := by norm_num
      rw [this, Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [h]
    calc (2:ℝ) ^ (1511:ℕ) < (2 * 3.1415926535 / 2.7182818286 : ℝ) ^ (1250:ℕ) := by norm_num
      _ < (2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1) ^ (1250:ℕ) :=

    rw [Real.logb_lt_iff_lt_rpow (by norm_num) hy]
    apply lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 1000 (Real.rpow_nonneg (by norm_num) _)
    have h : ((2:ℝ) ^ ((1209:ℝ)/1000)) ^ (1000:ℕ) = 2 ^ (1209:ℕ) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_natCast, ← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
      have : (1209:ℝ)/1000 * ((1000:ℕ):ℝ) = ((1209:ℕ):ℝ) := by norm_num
      rw [this, Real.rpow_natCast]
    rw [h]
    calc (2 * Real.pi / Real.exp 1) ^ (1000:ℕ)
